phase_policies.applies_when: Early game, own ground macro posture with heavy production and tech, opponent posture unknown but heavy economy and tech.
phase_policies.live_check: Re-evaluate when opponent's first combat units are scouted or when transitioning to midgame.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Develop economy and tech, keep production active, and ensure ground army presence.
phase_policies.target: Continue heavy production and technology, strengthen ground forces, and increase economy while maintaining expansion.
phase_policies.title: Heavy Tech/Economy Ground Core
phase_policies.veto: Do not neglect army production while teching; maintain a strong ground core for safety.

phase_policies.applies_when: Early-midgame, own ground macro with Siege Tanks and Marines, opponent ground posture with Warp Prism.
phase_policies.live_check: Re-check if opponent shows signs of air transition or heavy pressure.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Consolidate ground forces, maintain economy and production, and continue tech.
phase_policies.target: Continue strengthening ground forces, maintain economy and production, and keep tech development on track.
phase_policies.title: Ground Consolidation with Tech
phase_policies.veto: Do not overextend without scouting; watch for Warp Prism harass.

phase_policies.applies_when: Midgame, own ground macro with Siege Tanks, Marines, Marauders, and Hellions, opponent ground posture with Stalkers and Immortals.
phase_policies.live_check: Re-evaluate if opponent transitions to more air or heavy splash damage.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Add air support while maintaining ground strength and economy.
phase_policies.target: Increase air presence and technology, continue strengthening ground forces, and maintain economy.
phase_policies.title: Ground with Air Support
phase_policies.veto: Do not neglect ground army while transitioning to air; keep a balanced force.

phase_policies.applies_when: Late-midgame, own ground macro with Siege Tanks, Marines, Marauders, and Medivacs, opponent ground posture with Stalkers and Immortals.
phase_policies.live_check: Re-evaluate when opponent's composition is fully revealed.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Maintain ground forces, continue production and tech, and expand economy.
phase_policies.target: Maintain ground strength, continue production and tech, and keep economy and expansion heavy.
phase_policies.title: Late Ground with Medivacs
phase_policies.veto: Do not neglect ground army when focusing on air; keep ground presence.

experiment_feedback.use_boundary: Prioritize execution risks only; never infer the strategic target from agent outcomes.
